_comment: Editable presentation settings for the prototype app. Nothing here affects the fitted model: the profile block only describes how the page maps familiar clinical, microbiological, and omics inputs onto the single standardized feature the surrogate was trained on. Edit freely and redeploy.
tagline: A functional prototype linking a mechanistic transmission model to a missing-data-aware machine-learning surrogate.
attribution: Created by our team for the Wellcome Leap AMPLIFY proposal.
license: Open source release planned; see the repository for current terms.

profile.label: Carrier profile
profile.note: Colonisation, exposure, and contact measurements for the individual. Together they set a single standardized transmissibility index, which is the quantity the fitted surrogate consumes.
profile.index_note: Index = 0 is an average carrier. It is capped at ±3, the range the training data covers.

modifiers.label: Antibiotic exposure in the last 30 days

options.label: Resistance gene on a conjugative plasmid
Several devices, or an open wound

organism_note: Which of the two calibrated antibiotic-resistant organisms the individual is carrying.

scenarios.label: ESBL-producing E. coli
scenarios.note: Stands in for the lower-transmission organism, calibrated to a population R₀ near 1.5.

scenarios.label: Carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae
scenarios.note: Stands in for the higher-transmission organism, calibrated to a population R₀ near 3.0.
